# Privé Motors

> Privé Motors is a luxury and exotic car rental service based in Dubai, UAE, offering concierge-standard delivery of sports, executive, and luxury vehicles anywhere in the Emirates, including direct-to-airport handoff.

Privé Motors operates a fleet of 24+ vehicles across brands including Lamborghini, Ferrari, Rolls-Royce, Bentley, Porsche, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Chevrolet, Tesla, and Range Rover. Rentals are booked directly through the website with real daily pricing (no bait pricing), and vehicles are delivered to the customer's home, hotel, or the airport.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.prive-motors.com/): Overview of the service and brand promise.
- [The Collection](https://www.prive-motors.com/collection.html): Full fleet listing with pricing, filterable by category, brand, occasion, and budget.
- [About Us](https://www.prive-motors.com/about.html): Company background.
- [Contact](https://www.prive-motors.com/contact.html): Concierge contact via WhatsApp and email.

## Notes

- Pricing shown on vehicle pages is per-day AED pricing; weekly and monthly rates are available on request.
- Contact is handled via WhatsApp and email; there is no public street address as this is a delivery-only concierge fleet operator.
